profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer and Automation Lead
profile.jobTitle: Staff Software Engineer and Automation Lead

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer and Automation Lead
QA Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Develop and implement mobile apps test case scenarios from the requirements and design to manage bug tracking, test analysis, sanity, smoke, regression testing and reporting.
- Apply the software development lifecycle: analyze, design, build, test, implement and release management.
- Conduct software compatibility tests with JIRA, Confluence and Test Rail for mobile apps in multiple platforms (iOS, Android)

positions.title: Bluetooth RF Test Engineer
positions.description:
- Analyze, modify and execute BT RF automation test scripts on FFA configurations using scripts in C++ on all required MSM products lines.
- Build and execute Bluetooth device interoperability tests with off the shelf top of the line BT devices such as: headsets, car kits, printers, dongles, phones, etc.
- Sanity testing on all MSM products using WinDBG for debugging and Frontline Comprobe Protocol Analysis System for reporting and collection of bugs/crashes.

positions.title: Research Assistant Intern
positions.description:
- Programmed C++ and C# excel applications for the technology team to facilitate the import of information to a database efficiently.

- Evaluated firewalls for the Technology lab to create a safer environment and protect each individual host and the firms proprietary.
